validity.researcher_notes: By its own name this row is a LOOPLINE — SSGC's network table (see spec entry above) shows it running parallel to the IRBP trunk (Dadu-Malir-Karachi), the same pattern the brief flags for P4016: a loopline's commissioning is a later capacity-expansion event, not the date of the field/area it passes through. I searched for a 'Bajara' gas field or location in Dadu district, Sindh, specifically (multiple phrasings, incl. site-restricted and OR-operator queries against SSGC/PPL/OGDCL) and found no independent source naming a Bajara field, facility, or the loopline's construction/commissioning year at all — only SSGC's own network table, which has no dates. This is a case where the row is real (confirmed by SSGC's own document) but the specific flagged question (StartYear1) has no available textual source; UNRESOLVED is the correct outcome rather than inferring a date from an unrelated event.
